therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin alone
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Adjusted mean change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24 (LOCF)

results.effect_size: HbA1c change vs placebo: -0.38% (2.5 mg), -0.41% (5 mg), -0.54% (10 mg) at Week 24
results.target_engagement_evidence: Rapid reduction in fasting plasma glucose observed as early as Week 1 (up to -16.5 mg/dL for 10 mg dose)
biomarker_changes: HbA1c reduced by -0.67%, -0.70%, -0.84% for 2.5, 5, 10 mg dapagliflozin vs -0.30% placebo at Week 24
Fasting plasma glucose reduced by -17.8, -21.5, -23.5 mg/dL for 2.5, 5, 10 mg dapagliflozin vs -6.0 mg/dL placebo at Week 24
Total body weight reduced by -2.21, -3.04, -2.86 kg for 2.5, 5, 10 mg dapagliflozin vs -0.89 kg placebo at Week 24
Seated systolic blood pressure reductions up to -5.1 mmHg (10 mg, Week 24) vs -0.2 mmHg placebo
Phosphorus inorganic (high) observed in 5 participants in 10 mg arm vs 1 in placebo
Hemoglobin >18 g/dL observed in more dapagliflozin-treated participants (up to 5 in 10 mg arm)
subgroup_findings: In participants with baseline HbA1c ≥9.0%: HbA1c change -1.21%, -1.37%, -1.32% for 2.5, 5, 10 mg vs -0.53% placebo
In participants with baseline BMI ≥27 kg/m²: body weight change -2.39, -3.21, -3.09 kg vs -1.01 kg placebo
In participants with baseline BMI ≥27 kg/m²: HbA1c change -0.69%, -0.71%, -0.88% vs -0.31% placebo
40.6% of 10 mg arm achieved HbA1c <7.0% vs 25.9% placebo at Week 24
25.2% of 10 mg arm achieved HbA1c ≤6.5% vs 13.8% placebo at Week 24
safety_signals: Hypoglycemia events were low and similar across arms (5-8 participants per arm over 102 weeks)
No hypoglycemia events led to discontinuation in any arm
Related SAEs were low (0-3 per arm)
Renal cell carcinoma reported as SAE in placebo arm
Breast cancer and malignant melanoma reported as SAEs in 10 mg arm
Orthostatic hypotension rates were similar across arms at most timepoints

dose_info.dose: 2.5 mg, 5 mg, or 10 mg dapagliflozin; ≥1500 mg/day metformin
dose_info.schedule: once daily for up to 102 weeks

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Metformin suppresses hepatic glucose output via AMPK activation, complementing dapagliflozin's renal glucose excretion to produce additive glycemic lowering beyond either agent alone
modulation_entries.citation: Dapagliflozin, 2.5-, 5-, or 10-mg dose once daily...Metformin administered as ≥1500 mg per day...adjusted mean change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24 showed greater reductions in all dapagliflozin+metformin arms vs placebo+metformin
